newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil interested in Faroese licensing round.
newsitem.headline: Statoil interested in Faroese licensing round.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it would be among the oil companies that nominate blocks for the first licensing round on the Faroese shelf.
The Faroese Hydrocarbon Planning Commission recently sent invitations to companies asking them for nominations by December 5.
"Statoil will be notifying the commission of the areas around the Faroe Islands that we find interesting," Vidar Larsen of Statoil Denmark told the company's Status Weekly newsletter.
"I am looking forward to the new licensing round starting in the second half of 1997," he added.
The newsletter said up to 20 oil companies had shown an interest in the Faroese shelf and many were involved in the Faroese Lopra-1 well project.
